## 2. Applicability

Use when a project needs exact public upstream code without turning Elite or the project into a Git repository. Adoption requires PowerShell 7, network access for acquisition, enough disk for source/models, an approved upstream selection and preservation of licenses/notices. Reject moving branches, missing hashes, restricted sources outside their allowed service, or claims that these primitives already implement REVESTEX business rules.

The acquisition and invocation scripts are `AUTHORED` orchestration. They do not impersonate upstream code. The downloaded archives are official source at the exact commits in the lock. Spec Kit and Docling execute from those official sources/dependencies.

## 3. Architecture contract

The lock is the only source-selection authority. The acquisition runner validates schema, unique identifiers, HTTPS GitHub commit URLs, lowercase SHA-256 and expected license metadata before network I/O. Archives are downloaded to an isolated temporary directory, hashed before extraction, inspected for traversal, expanded under one source root and moved only into an absent destination. A receipt is written beside, not inside, the upstream source tree.

The Spec Kit bootstrap verifies the official source commit metadata, builds an isolated virtual environment, installs from the acquired source and invokes the official `specify init` command. It never initializes Git. The Docling runner invokes the official CLI, refuses remote inputs, enables local OCR/tables, emits structured outputs and hashes them. Neither script stores secrets or accepts document URLs.

Failures are closed: hash mismatch, unsafe archive path, non-empty/occupied target, unexpected version, missing output or subprocess nonzero aborts. Acquisition rollback is deletion of the newly created project-local `elite_upstreams` directory after preserving receipts/evidence; project code and source databases are never modified by the acquisition runner.

Performance budget: lock validation under 2 seconds; cached bootstrap overhead excluding package installation under 30 seconds; document conversion budget is project/corpus-specific and cannot be claimed globally. Initial model acquisition is an explicit network/capacity condition.

````json
      "platform_condition": "The verified SAP sample demonstrates project roles, current-validator assignment, distinct-role forwarding, correction reasons and decision history, but it is not safe or reproducible for immediate adoption. Generated audits found 5 UI and 17 router advisories, while the exact Python 3.11 Linux lock resolved 41 packages with 160 advisories across 14 packages. No ETag/CAS or assignment lease exists; setCV does not prove invoice/project binding; CSRF is disabled for API/snapshot routes; mta destinations use strictSSL:false; and the unauthenticated snapshot service writes concurrent requests to fixed shared files. REUSE.toml also restricts external-product API calls absent separate SAP agreements.       "platform_condition": "This signed Microsoft main commit is newer than stable v2.1.2 and remains unreleased. It provides exact multi-document Extract-Map-Evaluate-Save, queue/workflow, gap analysis, editable results and comments, and its three Python component suites pass 554 tests from frozen uv locks; the web build also passes. It is rejected for immediate adoption because the canonical web gate still fails 3 of 12 suites on react-router ESM loading, production dependency audits report 5 web vulnerabilities plus 5 Processor, 3 API and 6 Workflow Python findings, and human corrections are not production-safe: processed-result updates filter only by process_id, overwrite without ETag/version/lease, persist last_modified_by as the literal user, accept no mandatory reason and retain no immutable correction history. Claim comments likewise update without a caller-provided version; EasyAuth identity is sent to telemetry but not persisted as the reviewer. Azure AI/OpenAI, Blob, Cosmos and deployment services require project-owned accounts, authorization and cost acceptance. Do not compose this branch into production or call its human-review path complete; retain its exact official primitives and failing evidence until Microsoft publishes a release whose frozen gates and required project controls pass.",

The release tag is lightweight and the commit is unsigned, so no signature is claimed. The suite is open source and may be used without cost for deployment testing; formal OpenID certification is a separate process that can require fees. Acquiring or running the suite does not prove a project's identity or authorization controls. Production admission requires fresh conformance output for the exact selected issuer/client/profile plus project-owned positive role journeys, unauthorized and cross-tenant negatives, logout/revocation/key-rotation/session-expiry evidence and approved break-glass governance, all bound to one immutable release."
    },
````

### FILE: `elite_sources/acquire_upstream_sources.ps1`
```yaml
block_id: "OFFICIAL-UPSTREAM-ACQUISITION:runner:v1"
operation: CREATE
provenance: AUTHORED
source: "local orchestration; downloaded source remains the exact official archive"
license: "LicenseRef-Workspace-Owner"
sha256: "d92a03687086cd7128f4d9ea61054c2409502bd4bf3dd4daab63758fa3337ba3"
variables: []
secrets_allowed: false
```
````powershell
#requires -Version 7.0
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$LockPath,
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Destination,
  [string[]]$SourceId = @(),
  [string]$ProfilePath = '',
  [string]$ApprovalPath = '',
  [string]$ImportDirectory = '',
  [switch]$ValidateOnly
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'opaque_artifact_transport.ps1')
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'quarantine_wheel_transport.ps1')

function Fail([string]$Message) { throw "UPSTREAM_ACQUISITION_FAILED: $Message" }
function Hash-File([string]$Path) {
  return (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
}
function Assert-SafeLeaf([string]$Value, [string]$Label) {
  if ($Value -notmatch '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{2,100}$') { Fail "$Label is not a safe leaf: $Value" }
}
function Assert-Hash([string]$Value, [string]$Label) {
  if ($Value -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { Fail "$Label is not lowercase SHA-256" }
}
function Assert-SafeRelativePath([string]$Value, [string]$Label) {
  $normalized = $Value.Replace('\', '/')
  $segments = $normalized.Split('/', [StringSplitOptions]::None)
  if (
    [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value) -or
    [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($Value) -or
    $segments.Count -eq 0 -or
    $segments -contains '' -or
    $segments -contains '.' -or
    $segments -contains '..'
  ) { Fail "$Label is unsafe: $Value" }
  return $normalized
}
function Assert-SafeSymlinkTarget([string]$LinkPath, [string]$Target, [string]$Label) {
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Target) -or [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($Target)) { Fail "$Label is unsafe: $Target" }
  $normalized = $Target.Replace('\', '/')
  $boundary = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) 'elite-symlink-boundary'))
  $link = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $boundary $LinkPath))
  $resolved = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($link)) $normalized))
  $prefix = $boundary.TrimEnd([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar, [IO.Path]::AltDirectorySeparatorChar) + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
  if (-not $resolved.StartsWith($prefix, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { Fail "$Label escapes the archive root: $Target" }
  return $normalized
}

$resolvedLock = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($LockPath)
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resolvedLock -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "lock not found: $resolvedLock" }
if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $resolvedLock).Length -gt 8388608) { Fail 'lock exceeds read budget' }
try { $lock = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolvedLock, $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20 }
catch { Fail "lock is not valid JSON: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
if ($lock.schema -ne 'elite-official-source-lock/v1') { Fail 'unsupported lock schema' }
if ($lock.sources -isnot [array] -or $lock.sources.Count -eq 0) { Fail 'sources must be a non-empty array' }

$ids = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
foreach ($source in $lock.sources) {
  Assert-SafeLeaf ([string]$source.id) 'source id'
  if (-not $ids.Add([string]$source.id)) { Fail "duplicate source id: $($source.id)" }
  if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'transport_kind' -and $source.transport_kind -cin @('quarantined-pypi-wheel/v1','quarantined-npm-tarball/v1')) { Assert-QuarantineSource $source; continue }
  if ([string]$source.commit -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') { Fail "invalid commit: $($source.id)" }
  if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'transport_kind') {
    Assert-OpaqueSource $source (Split-Path -Parent $resolvedLock) -MetadataOnly
    continue
  }
  Assert-Hash ([string]$source.archive_sha256) "archive hash for $($source.id)"
  Assert-Hash ([string]$source.license_sha256) "license hash for $($source.id)"
  $expectedUrl = "https://github.com/$($source.repository)/archive/$($source.commit).zip"
  if ([string]$source.archive_url -cne $expectedUrl) { Fail "archive URL is not the exact GitHub commit URL: $($source.id)" }
  if ([long]$source.archive_bytes -le 0) { Fail "archive size is invalid: $($source.id)" }
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$source.license_expression)) { Fail "license expression missing: $($source.id)" }
  [void](Assert-SafeRelativePath ([string]$source.license_path) "license path for $($source.id)")
  foreach ($artifact in @(
    @('notice_path','notice_sha256'),
    @('lock_path','lock_sha256'),
    @('package_license_path','package_license_sha256'),
    @('package_pyproject_path','package_pyproject_sha256'),
    @('package_manifest_path','package_manifest_sha256'),
    @('package_test_runner_path','package_test_runner_sha256'),
    @('package_constraints_path','package_constraints_sha256'),
    @('package_assets_path','package_assets_sha256'),
    @('service_ci_path','service_ci_sha256'),
    @('service_tests_path','service_tests_sha256')
  )) {
    $pathName = $artifact[0]
    $hashName = $artifact[1]
    $hasPath = $source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $pathName
    $hasHash = $source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $hashName
    if ($hasPath -ne $hasHash) { Fail "optional artifact path/hash pair is incomplete for $($source.id): $pathName/$hashName" }
    if ($hasPath) {
      [void](Assert-SafeRelativePath ([string]$source.$pathName) "$pathName for $($source.id)")
      Assert-Hash ([string]$source.$hashName) "$hashName for $($source.id)"
    }
  }
  if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'additional_artifacts') {
    if ($source.additional_artifacts -isnot [array] -or $source.additional_artifacts.Count -eq 0) { Fail "additional_artifacts must be a non-empty array: $($source.id)" }
    $additionalPaths = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
    foreach ($additional in $source.additional_artifacts) {
      if ($additional.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains 'path' -or $additional.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains 'sha256' -or $additional.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains 'purpose') { Fail "additional artifact is incomplete: $($source.id)" }
      $safePath = Assert-SafeRelativePath ([string]$additional.path) "additional artifact path for $($source.id)"
      if (-not $additionalPaths.Add($safePath)) { Fail "duplicate additional artifact path for $($source.id): $safePath" }
      Assert-Hash ([string]$additional.sha256) "additional artifact hash for $($source.id): $safePath"
      if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$additional.purpose)) { Fail "additional artifact purpose is missing for $($source.id): $safePath" }
    }
  }
  if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'supported_platforms') {
    if ($source.supported_platforms -isnot [array] -or $source.supported_platforms.Count -eq 0) { Fail "supported_platforms must be a non-empty array: $($source.id)" }
    foreach ($platform in $source.supported_platforms) {
      if ([string]$platform -notin @('windows','linux','macos')) { Fail "unsupported platform label for $($source.id): $platform" }
    }
  }
  if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'archive_symlinks') {
    if ($source.archive_symlinks -isnot [array] -or $source.archive_symlinks.Count -eq 0) { Fail "archive_symlinks must be a non-empty array: $($source.id)" }
    if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains 'supported_platforms' -or 'windows' -in @($source.supported_platforms)) { Fail "archive symlinks require an explicit non-Windows platform restriction: $($source.id)" }
    $symlinkPaths = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
    foreach ($symlink in $source.archive_symlinks) {
      if ($symlink.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains 'path' -or $symlink.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains 'target' -or $symlink.kind -cnotin @('directory','file')) { Fail "archive symlink declaration is incomplete: $($source.id)" }
      $linkPath = Assert-SafeRelativePath ([string]$symlink.path) "archive symlink path for $($source.id)"
      if (-not $symlinkPaths.Add($linkPath)) { Fail "duplicate archive symlink path for $($source.id): $linkPath" }
      [void](Assert-SafeSymlinkTarget $linkPath ([string]$symlink.target) "archive symlink target for $($source.id): $linkPath")
    }
  }
}

$selected = @($lock.sources | Where-Object { $SourceId.Count -eq 0 -or $SourceId -contains $_.id })
if ($SourceId.Count -gt 0) {
  $selectedIds = @($selected | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.id })
  foreach ($requested in $SourceId) {
    if ($requested -notin $selectedIds) { Fail "requested source is not locked: $requested" }
  }
}
foreach ($source in $selected) {
  if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'transport_kind' -and $source.transport_kind -cin @('quarantined-pypi-wheel/v1','quarantined-npm-tarball/v1')) { Assert-QuarantineSource $source }
  elseif ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'transport_kind') { Assert-OpaqueSource $source (Split-Path -Parent $resolvedLock) }
  elseif ($ImportDirectory) { Fail 'ImportDirectory is supported only for opaque release artifacts' }
}
if ($ValidateOnly) {
  Write-Output "UPSTREAM_LOCK_VALID sources=$($lock.sources.Count) selected=$($selected.Count)"
  exit 0
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ProfilePath) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ApprovalPath)) {
  Fail 'ProfilePath and ApprovalPath are required for acquisition'
}
$resolvedProfile = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ProfilePath)
$resolvedApproval = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ApprovalPath)
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resolvedProfile -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "profile not found: $resolvedProfile" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resolvedApproval -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "approval not found: $resolvedApproval" }
if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $resolvedProfile).Length -gt 1048576 -or (Get-Item -LiteralPath $resolvedApproval).Length -gt 1048576) { Fail 'profile or approval exceeds read budget' }
try { $profile = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolvedProfile, $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20 }
catch { Fail "profile is not valid JSON: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
try { $approval = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolvedApproval, $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20 }
catch { Fail "approval is not valid JSON: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
if ($profile.schema -cne 'elite-official-source-profile/v1') { Fail 'unsupported profile schema' }
if ($approval.schema -cne 'elite-project-official-source-profile-approval/v1') { Fail 'unsupported approval schema' }
if ($approval.profile_id -cne $profile.profile_id) { Fail 'approval profile_id mismatch' }
if ($approval.profile_sha256 -cne (Hash-File $resolvedProfile)) { Fail 'approval profile_sha256 mismatch' }
if ($approval.lock_sha256 -cne (Hash-File $resolvedLock)) { Fail 'approval lock_sha256 mismatch' }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$approval.approved_by)) { Fail 'approved_by is required' }
$approvalTime = [DateTimeOffset]::MinValue
if (-not [DateTimeOffset]::TryParse([string]$approval.approved_at, [ref]$approvalTime)) { Fail 'approved_at is invalid' }
if ($profile.source_ids -isnot [array] -or $profile.required_user_inputs -isnot [array] -or $profile.production_blockers -isnot [array]) { Fail 'profile approval surfaces are invalid' }
$profileIds = @($profile.source_ids | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ } | Sort-Object)
$selectedIds = @($selected | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.id } | Sort-Object)
if (($profileIds -join "`n") -cne ($selectedIds -join "`n")) { Fail 'selected sources do not exactly match approved profile' }
if ($approval.answers -isnot [array]) { Fail 'approval answers must be an array' }
$answers = @{}
foreach ($answer in $approval.answers) {
  $input = [string]$answer.input
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($input) -or $answers.ContainsKey($input)) { Fail "invalid or duplicate approval answer: $input" }
  if ([string]$answer.status -notin @('ANSWERED','PROVEN','NONE_WITH_REASON')) { Fail "approval answer is not closed: $input" }
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$answer.response_or_reason)) { Fail "approval answer has no response or reason: $input" }
  $answers[$input] = $answer
}
foreach ($requiredInput in $profile.required_user_inputs) {
  if (-not $answers.ContainsKey([string]$requiredInput)) { Fail "required user input is unanswered: $requiredInput" }
}
if ($answers.Count -ne $profile.required_user_inputs.Count) { Fail 'approval contains answers not declared by the profile' }
if ($approval.production_blockers_acknowledged -isnot [array]) { Fail 'production blockers acknowledgement must be an array' }
$expectedBlockers = @($profile.production_blockers | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ } | Sort-Object)
$actualBlockers = @($approval.production_blockers_acknowledged | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ } | Sort-Object)
if (($expectedBlockers -join "`n") -cne ($actualBlockers -join "`n")) { Fail 'production blockers acknowledgement does not match profile' }

$currentPlatform = if ([OperatingSystem]::IsWindows()) { 'windows' } elseif ([OperatingSystem]::IsLinux()) { 'linux' } elseif ([OperatingSystem]::IsMacOS()) { 'macos' } else { 'unknown' }
foreach ($source in $selected) {
  if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'supported_platforms' -and $currentPlatform -notin @($source.supported_platforms)) {
    Fail "source $($source.id) cannot be materialized on $currentPlatform; supported=$(@($source.supported_platforms) -join ',') condition=$($source.platform_condition)"
  }
}

$destinationRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Destination)
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destinationRoot)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destinationRoot) }
$sourceRoot = Join-Path $destinationRoot 'sources'
$receiptRoot = Join-Path $destinationRoot 'receipts'
[void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $sourceRoot, $receiptRoot)

foreach ($source in $selected) {
  $target = Join-Path $sourceRoot $source.id
  $receipt = Join-Path $receiptRoot ($source.id + '.json')
  if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'transport_kind' -and $source.transport_kind -cin @('quarantined-pypi-wheel/v1','quarantined-npm-tarball/v1')) {
    Invoke-QuarantineAcquisition $source $resolvedLock $target $receipt $resolvedProfile $resolvedApproval $ImportDirectory
    continue
  }
  if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'transport_kind') {
    Invoke-OpaqueAcquisition $source $resolvedLock $target $receipt $resolvedProfile $resolvedApproval $ImportDirectory
    continue
  }
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) {
    Fail "legacy source cache cannot prove extracted bytes; preserve it and acquire into a new destination: $($source.id)"
  }

  $tempRoot = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('elite-upstream-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
  try {
    [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tempRoot)
    $archive = Join-Path $tempRoot 'source.zip'
    Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $source.archive_url -OutFile $archive
    $actualBytes = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $archive).Length
    if ($actualBytes -ne [long]$source.archive_bytes) { Fail "archive size mismatch for $($source.id): $actualBytes" }
    $actualHash = Hash-File $archive
    if ($actualHash -cne $source.archive_sha256) { Fail "archive hash mismatch for $($source.id): $actualHash" }

    $zip = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($archive)
    try {
      $roots = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
      foreach ($entry in $zip.Entries) {
        $name = $entry.FullName.Replace('\', '/')
        if ($name.StartsWith('/') -or $name -match '(^|/)\.\.(/|$)' -or $name -match '^[A-Za-z]:') {
          Fail "unsafe archive entry for $($source.id): $name"
        }
        $root = $name.Split('/', 2)[0]
        if ($root) { [void]$roots.Add($root) }
      }
      if ($roots.Count -ne 1) { Fail "archive must contain exactly one root: $($source.id)" }
      $archiveRoot = @($roots)[0]
      $declaredSymlinks = @{}
      if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'archive_symlinks') {
        foreach ($symlink in @($source.archive_symlinks)) { $declaredSymlinks[[string]$symlink.path] = [string]$symlink.target }
      }
      $actualSymlinks = @{}
      foreach ($entry in $zip.Entries) {
        $name = $entry.FullName.Replace('\', '/')
        $unixMode = (($entry.ExternalAttributes -shr 16) -band 0xFFFF)
        if (($unixMode -band 0xF000) -eq 0xA000) {
          $relative = $name.Substring($archiveRoot.Length + 1)
          $stream = $entry.Open()
          $reader = [IO.StreamReader]::new($stream, $utf8, $true, 1024, $false)
          try { $actualSymlinks[$relative] = $reader.ReadToEnd() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
        }
      }
      if ($actualSymlinks.Count -ne $declaredSymlinks.Count) { Fail "archive symlink inventory mismatch for $($source.id): actual=$($actualSymlinks.Count) declared=$($declaredSymlinks.Count)" }
      foreach ($path in $actualSymlinks.Keys) {
        if (-not $declaredSymlinks.ContainsKey($path) -or $actualSymlinks[$path] -cne $declaredSymlinks[$path]) { Fail "archive symlink missing, undeclared or target-mismatched for $($source.id): $path" }
      }
    } finally { $zip.Dispose() }

    $expanded = Join-Path $tempRoot 'expanded'
    Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $expanded
    $extractedRoot = Join-Path $expanded $archiveRoot
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $extractedRoot -PathType Container)) { Fail "archive root missing: $($source.id)" }
    if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'archive_symlinks') {
      foreach ($symlink in @($source.archive_symlinks)) {
        $linkPath = Join-Path $extractedRoot ([string]$symlink.path)
        $targetValue = [string]$symlink.target
        $targetPath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($linkPath)) $targetValue))
        $targetType = if ($symlink.kind -ceq 'directory') { 'Container' } else { 'Leaf' }
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $targetPath -PathType $targetType)) { Fail "archive symlink $($symlink.kind) target missing for $($source.id): $($symlink.path)" }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $linkPath) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $linkPath -Force }
        if ($symlink.kind -ceq 'directory') {
          [void][IO.Directory]::CreateSymbolicLink($linkPath, $targetValue)
        } else {
          [void][IO.File]::CreateSymbolicLink($linkPath, $targetValue)
        }
        $materializedLink = Get-Item -LiteralPath $linkPath -Force
        if ($materializedLink.LinkType -cne 'SymbolicLink' -or [string]$materializedLink.LinkTarget -cne $targetValue) { Fail "archive symlink was not preserved for $($source.id): $($symlink.path)" }
      }
    }
    $licenseFile = Join-Path $extractedRoot ([string]$source.license_path)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $licenseFile -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "license missing: $($source.id)" }
    if ((Hash-File $licenseFile) -cne $source.license_sha256) { Fail "license hash mismatch: $($source.id)" }
    foreach ($artifact in @(
      @('notice_path','notice_sha256','notice'),
      @('lock_path','lock_sha256','dependency lock'),
      @('package_license_path','package_license_sha256','package license'),
      @('package_pyproject_path','package_pyproject_sha256','package pyproject'),
      @('package_manifest_path','package_manifest_sha256','package build manifest'),
      @('package_test_runner_path','package_test_runner_sha256','package test runner'),
      @('package_constraints_path','package_constraints_sha256','package test constraints'),
      @('package_assets_path','package_assets_sha256','package test assets lock'),
      @('service_ci_path','service_ci_sha256','service CI'),
      @('service_tests_path','service_tests_sha256','service tests CI')
    )) {
      $pathName = $artifact[0]
      $hashName = $artifact[1]
      $label = $artifact[2]
      if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $pathName) {
        $artifactFile = Join-Path $extractedRoot ([string]$source.$pathName)
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifactFile -PathType Leaf) -or (Hash-File $artifactFile) -cne $source.$hashName) {
          Fail "$label missing or mismatched: $($source.id)"
        }
      }
    }
    if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'additional_artifacts') {
      foreach ($additional in @($source.additional_artifacts)) {
        $artifactFile = Join-Path $extractedRoot ([string]$additional.path)
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifactFile -PathType Leaf) -or (Hash-File $artifactFile) -cne $additional.sha256) {
          Fail "additional artifact missing or mismatched: $($source.id): $($additional.path)"
        }
      }
    }

    Move-Item -LiteralPath $extractedRoot -Destination $target
    $record = [ordered]@{
      schema = 'elite-official-source-receipt/v1'
      id = $source.id
      repository = $source.repository
      release = $source.release
      commit = $source.commit
      archive_url = $source.archive_url
      archive_bytes = $actualBytes
      archive_sha256 = $actualHash
      license_expression = $source.license_expression
      additional_artifacts_verified = if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'additional_artifacts') { @($source.additional_artifacts).Count } else { 0 }
      archive_symlinks_verified = if ($source.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'archive_symlinks') { @($source.archive_symlinks).Count } else { 0 }
      platform = $currentPlatform
      acquired_at = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
    }
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($receipt, (($record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) + "`n"), $utf8)
    Write-Output "UPSTREAM_SOURCE_ACQUIRED id=$($source.id)"
  } finally {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tempRoot) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempRoot -Recurse -Force }
  }
}
````

```yaml
block_id: "OFFICIAL-UPSTREAM-ACQUISITION:spec-kit-bootstrap:v1"
operation: CREATE
provenance: AUTHORED
source: "local wrapper invoking the exact official GitHub Spec Kit source"
license: "LicenseRef-Workspace-Owner"
sha256: "23c63cd72892e32db5e06b832c9eba30722c8e43e53ea010e357b20a7466891a"
variables: []
secrets_allowed: false
```
````powershell
#requires -Version 7.0
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SpecKitSource,
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ProjectDirectory,
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$PythonExecutable,
  [ValidateSet('codex','claude')][string]$Integration = 'codex'
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
function Fail([string]$Message) { throw "SPEC_KIT_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED: $Message" }

$source = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($SpecKitSource)
$project = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ProjectDirectory)
$python = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($PythonExecutable)
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $python -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "Python executable not found: $python" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $source 'pyproject.toml') -PathType Leaf)) { Fail 'Spec Kit pyproject.toml missing' }
$projectText = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $source 'pyproject.toml'), $utf8)
if ($projectText -notmatch '(?m)^name = "specify-cli"$' -or $projectText -notmatch '(?m)^version = "1\.0\.1"$') {
  Fail 'source is not specify-cli 1.0.1'
}
if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $source 'LICENSE') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -cne '2510b446bc1f0cf9702453075d20cd88631e20e5642658edb7325d9c1eb534f7') {
  Fail 'Spec Kit license hash mismatch'
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $project '.git')) { Fail 'target already contains .git; this bootstrap is the no-Git profile' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $project '.specify')) { Fail 'target already contains .specify' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $project)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $project) }

$venv = Join-Path $project '.specify-venv'
& $python -m venv $venv
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Fail "venv creation exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
$venvPython = if ($IsWindows) { Join-Path $venv 'Scripts/python.exe' } else { Join-Path $venv 'bin/python' }
$specify = if ($IsWindows) { Join-Path $venv 'Scripts/specify.exe' } else { Join-Path $venv 'bin/specify' }
& $venvPython -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check $source
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Fail "Spec Kit installation exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
$version = (& $specify --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
if ($version -notmatch '1\.0\.1') { Fail "unexpected specify version: $version" }

Push-Location $project
try {
  & $specify init --here --force --non-interactive --ignore-agent-tools --integration $Integration --script ps
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Fail "official specify init exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
} finally { Pop-Location }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $project '.specify') -PathType Container)) { Fail '.specify was not generated' }
$agentPath = if ($Integration -eq 'codex') { '.agents/skills' } else { '.claude/skills' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $project $agentPath) -PathType Container)) { Fail "$Integration integration was not generated" }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $project '.git')) { Fail 'official bootstrap unexpectedly created .git' }

$record = [ordered]@{
  schema = 'elite-spec-kit-bootstrap/v1'
  upstream = 'github/spec-kit'
  version = '1.0.1'
  commit = '9118ed15a0ba65053469a94c560ea5d233f75884'
  integration = $Integration
  git_repository_created = $false
  generated_at = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $project 'SPEC_KIT_BOOTSTRAP_RECORD.json'), (($record | ConvertTo-Json) + "`n"), $utf8)
Write-Output "SPEC_KIT_BOOTSTRAP_PASS integration=$Integration git=false"
````

### FILE: `elite_sources/docling_official_convert.py`
```yaml
block_id: "OFFICIAL-UPSTREAM-ACQUISITION:docling-python:v1"
operation: CREATE
provenance: AUTHORED
source: "local wrapper using only the pinned official Docling public API"
license: "LicenseRef-Workspace-Owner"
sha256: "2dcf58198eecca0e977af1b1b5c952ae1bb014dd628c3a04063d4fb4bf36f961"
variables: []
secrets_allowed: false
```
````python
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path

from docling.datamodel.accelerator_options import AcceleratorDevice
from docling.datamodel.base_models import InputFormat
from docling.datamodel.document import ConversionStatus
from docling.datamodel.pipeline_options import PdfPipelineOptions, RapidOcrOptions
from docling.document_converter import DocumentConverter, PdfFormatOption


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--input", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--ocr-backend", choices=("torch", "onnxruntime"), default="torch")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if importlib.metadata.version("docling") != "2.122.0":
        raise RuntimeError("docling 2.122.0 is required")
    source = args.input.resolve(strict=True)
    if source.suffix.lower() != ".pdf":
        raise ValueError("this verified profile accepts local PDF files only")
    output = args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    options = PdfPipelineOptions()
    options.do_ocr = True
    options.do_table_structure = True
    options.table_structure_options.do_cell_matching = True
    options.ocr_options = RapidOcrOptions(backend=args.ocr_backend)
    options.accelerator_options.device = AcceleratorDevice.CPU
    converter = DocumentConverter(
        format_options={InputFormat.PDF: PdfFormatOption(pipeline_options=options)}
    )
    result = converter.convert(source, raises_on_error=True)
    if result.status is not ConversionStatus.SUCCESS:
        raise RuntimeError(f"conversion did not succeed: {result.status}")

    markdown = result.document.export_to_markdown().encode("utf-8")
    structured = result.document.model_dump_json(indent=2).encode("utf-8")
    (output / f"{source.stem}.md").write_bytes(markdown)
    (output / f"{source.stem}.json").write_bytes(structured)
    print(json.dumps({"status": str(result.status), "markdown_bytes": len(markdown), "json_bytes": len(structured)}))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
````

### FILE: `elite_sources/invoke_docling_local.ps1`
```yaml
block_id: "OFFICIAL-UPSTREAM-ACQUISITION:docling-invoke:v1"
operation: CREATE
provenance: AUTHORED
source: "local wrapper invoking the exact official Docling CLI"
license: "LicenseRef-Workspace-Owner"
sha256: "409ddcaa7b5ba322ce9e09e89ed9dd3944093b096a4aaddd1ead35982d2809cd"
variables: []
secrets_allowed: false
```
````powershell
#requires -Version 7.0
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$PythonExecutable,
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$InputPath,
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$OutputDirectory,
  [ValidateSet('torch','onnxruntime')][string]$OcrBackend = 'torch'
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
function Fail([string]$Message) { throw "DOCLING_LOCAL_FAILED: $Message" }

$python = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($PythonExecutable)
$input = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($InputPath)
$output = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($OutputDirectory)
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $python -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "Python executable not found: $python" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $input -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "local input not found: $input" }
if ([IO.Path]::GetExtension($input).ToLowerInvariant() -ne '.pdf') { Fail 'verified profile accepts local PDF files only' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $output) {
  if ((Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $output -Force | Measure-Object).Count -gt 0) { Fail "output must be empty: $output" }
} else { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $output) }

$converter = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'docling_official_convert.py'
& $python $converter --input $input --output $output --ocr-backend $OcrBackend
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Fail "official Docling API wrapper exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
$artifacts = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $output -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in @('.md','.json') } | Sort-Object Name)
if (-not @($artifacts | Where-Object Extension -eq '.md') -or -not @($artifacts | Where-Object Extension -eq '.json')) {
  Fail 'Docling did not produce both Markdown and JSON'
}
$record = [ordered]@{
  schema = 'elite-docling-conversion/v1'
  upstream = 'docling-project/docling'
  version = '2.122.0'
  commit = 'facdd9bae5882c24c37d4e4c3ecb6e5510667c4d'
  input_name = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($input)
  input_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $input -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
  ocr_engine = 'rapidocr'
  ocr_backend = $OcrBackend
  device = 'cpu'
  artifacts = @($artifacts | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ name=$_.Name; bytes=$_.Length; sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() } })
  converted_at = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $output 'DOCLING_CONVERSION_RECORD.json'), (($record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6) + "`n"), $utf8)
Write-Output "DOCLING_LOCAL_PASS artifacts=$($artifacts.Count)"
````

### FILE: `elite_sources/apply_source_profile.ps1`
```yaml
block_id: "OFFICIAL-UPSTREAM-ACQUISITION:profile-runner:v1"
operation: CREATE
provenance: AUTHORED
source: "local orchestration over the exact official source lock; it does not implement upstream capabilities"
license: "LicenseRef-Workspace-Owner"
sha256: "d20d697a811bbfce43d968e8a3739a9265a9f5518a143f88f4a04676f674f52c"
variables: []
secrets_allowed: false
```
````powershell
#requires -Version 7.0
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ProfilePath,
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$LockPath,
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Destination,
  [string]$ApprovalPath = '',
  [string]$ImportDirectory = '',
  [switch]$ValidateOnly
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'opaque_artifact_transport.ps1')
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'quarantine_wheel_transport.ps1')

function Fail([string]$Message) { throw "SOURCE_PROFILE_FAILED: $Message" }
function Hash-File([string]$Path) {
  (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
}

$resolvedProfile = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ProfilePath)
$resolvedLock = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($LockPath)
$resolvedDestination = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Destination)
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resolvedProfile -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "profile not found: $resolvedProfile" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resolvedLock -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "lock not found: $resolvedLock" }

if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $resolvedProfile).Length -gt 1048576 -or (Get-Item -LiteralPath $resolvedLock).Length -gt 8388608) { Fail 'profile or lock exceeds read budget' }
try { $profile = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolvedProfile, $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20 }
catch { Fail "profile is not valid JSON: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
try { $lock = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolvedLock, $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20 }
catch { Fail "lock is not valid JSON: $($_.Exception.Message)" }

if ($profile.schema -cne 'elite-official-source-profile/v1') { Fail 'unsupported profile schema' }
if ([string]$profile.profile_id -notmatch '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{2,80}$') { Fail 'unsafe profile_id' }
if ($profile.source_ids -isnot [array] -or $profile.source_ids.Count -eq 0) { Fail 'source_ids must be a non-empty array' }
if ($profile.required_user_inputs -isnot [array] -or $profile.required_user_inputs.Count -eq 0) { Fail 'required_user_inputs must be explicit' }
if ($profile.production_blockers -isnot [array] -or $profile.production_blockers.Count -eq 0) { Fail 'production_blockers must be explicit' }
if ($lock.schema -cne 'elite-official-source-lock/v1') { Fail 'unsupported lock schema' }

$requested = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
foreach ($idValue in $profile.source_ids) {
  $id = [string]$idValue
  if ($id -notmatch '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{2,100}$') { Fail "unsafe source id: $id" }
  if (-not $requested.Add($id)) { Fail "duplicate source id: $id" }
}
$lockedById = @{}
foreach ($source in $lock.sources) { $lockedById[[string]$source.id] = $source }
foreach ($id in $requested) {
  if (-not $lockedById.ContainsKey($id)) { Fail "source is not in the exact lock: $id" }
}

if (-not $ValidateOnly) {
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ApprovalPath)) { Fail 'ApprovalPath is required for acquisition' }
  $resolvedApproval = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ApprovalPath)
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resolvedApproval -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "approval not found: $resolvedApproval" }
  if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $resolvedApproval).Length -gt 1048576) { Fail 'approval exceeds read budget' }
  try { $approval = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolvedApproval, $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20 }
  catch { Fail "approval is not valid JSON: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
  if ($approval.schema -cne 'elite-project-official-source-profile-approval/v1') { Fail 'unsupported approval schema' }
  if ($approval.profile_id -cne $profile.profile_id) { Fail 'approval profile_id mismatch' }
  if ($approval.profile_sha256 -cne (Hash-File $resolvedProfile)) { Fail 'approval profile_sha256 mismatch' }
  if ($approval.lock_sha256 -cne (Hash-File $resolvedLock)) { Fail 'approval lock_sha256 mismatch' }
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$approval.approved_by)) { Fail 'approved_by is required' }
  $approvalTime = [DateTimeOffset]::MinValue
  if (-not [DateTimeOffset]::TryParse([string]$approval.approved_at, [ref]$approvalTime)) { Fail 'approved_at is invalid' }
  if ($approval.answers -isnot [array]) { Fail 'approval answers must be an array' }
  $answers = @{}
  foreach ($answer in $approval.answers) {
    $input = [string]$answer.input
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($input) -or $answers.ContainsKey($input)) { Fail "invalid or duplicate approval answer: $input" }
    if ([string]$answer.status -notin @('ANSWERED','PROVEN','NONE_WITH_REASON')) { Fail "approval answer is not closed: $input" }
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$answer.response_or_reason)) { Fail "approval answer has no response or reason: $input" }
    $answers[$input] = $answer
  }
  foreach ($requiredInput in $profile.required_user_inputs) {
    if (-not $answers.ContainsKey([string]$requiredInput)) { Fail "required user input is unanswered: $requiredInput" }
  }
  if ($answers.Count -ne $profile.required_user_inputs.Count) { Fail 'approval contains answers not declared by the profile' }
  if ($approval.production_blockers_acknowledged -isnot [array]) { Fail 'production blockers acknowledgement must be an array' }
  $expectedBlockers = @($profile.production_blockers | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ } | Sort-Object)
  $actualBlockers = @($approval.production_blockers_acknowledged | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ } | Sort-Object)
  if (($expectedBlockers -join "`n") -cne ($actualBlockers -join "`n")) { Fail 'production blockers acknowledgement does not match profile' }
}

$acquirer = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $resolvedLock) 'acquire_upstream_sources.ps1'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $acquirer -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "acquirer not found beside lock: $acquirer" }
$orderedIds = @($profile.source_ids | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
if ($ValidateOnly) {
  & $acquirer -LockPath $resolvedLock -Destination $resolvedDestination -SourceId $orderedIds -ImportDirectory $ImportDirectory -ValidateOnly
  Write-Output "SOURCE_PROFILE_VALID profile=$($profile.profile_id) selected=$($orderedIds.Count)"
  exit 0
}

& $acquirer -LockPath $resolvedLock -Destination $resolvedDestination -SourceId $orderedIds -ProfilePath $resolvedProfile -ApprovalPath $resolvedApproval -ImportDirectory $ImportDirectory

$sourceReceipts = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
foreach ($id in $orderedIds) {
  $receiptPath = Join-Path $resolvedDestination "receipts/$id.json"
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $receiptPath -PathType Leaf)) { Fail "receipt missing after acquisition: $id" }
  $receipt = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($receiptPath, $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json
  $expected = $lockedById[$id]
  if ($expected.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'transport_kind' -and $expected.transport_kind -cin @('quarantined-pypi-wheel/v1','quarantined-npm-tarball/v1')) {
    Assert-QuarantineReceipt $expected $receipt $resolvedProfile $resolvedApproval $resolvedLock
  } elseif ($expected.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'transport_kind') {
    Assert-OpaqueReceipt $expected $receipt $resolvedProfile $resolvedApproval $resolvedLock
  } elseif ($receipt.commit -cne $expected.commit -or $receipt.archive_sha256 -cne $expected.archive_sha256) {
    Fail "receipt does not match exact lock: $id"
  }
  $sourceReceipts.Add([ordered]@{
    id = $id
    receipt = [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($resolvedDestination, $receiptPath).Replace('\', '/')
    receipt_sha256 = Hash-File $receiptPath
  })
}

$profileReceiptRoot = Join-Path $resolvedDestination 'profile-receipts'
Assert-OpaqueNoReparse $profileReceiptRoot
[void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $profileReceiptRoot)
$profileReceiptPath = Join-Path $profileReceiptRoot ($profile.profile_id + '.json')
$profileReceipt = [ordered]@{
  schema = 'elite-official-source-profile-receipt/v1'
  profile_id = [string]$profile.profile_id
  profile_sha256 = Hash-File $resolvedProfile
  lock_sha256 = Hash-File $resolvedLock
  approval_sha256 = Hash-File $resolvedApproval
  acquired_at = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
  source_receipts = @($sourceReceipts)
  production_status = 'BLOCKED_PENDING_USER_INPUTS_AND_LIVE_GATES'
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profileReceiptPath) {
  Assert-OpaqueNoReparse $profileReceiptPath
  if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $profileReceiptPath).Length -gt 1048576) { Fail 'profile receipt exceeds read budget' }
  $existing = Get-Content -LiteralPath $profileReceiptPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20
  foreach ($field in @('schema','profile_id','profile_sha256','lock_sha256','approval_sha256','production_status')) {
    if ($existing.$field -cne $profileReceipt[$field]) { Fail 'occupied profile receipt binding differs' }
  }
  if (($existing.source_receipts | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress) -cne ($profileReceipt.source_receipts | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress)) { Fail 'occupied profile receipt source evidence differs' }
  Write-Output "SOURCE_PROFILE_PRESENT profile=$($profile.profile_id) selected=$($orderedIds.Count) receipt=$profileReceiptPath"
  exit 0
}
$receiptBytes = $utf8.GetBytes(($profileReceipt | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) + "`n")
$receiptStream = [IO.FileStream]::new($profileReceiptPath,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write,[IO.FileShare]::None)
try { $receiptStream.Write($receiptBytes,0,$receiptBytes.Length); $receiptStream.Flush($true) } finally { $receiptStream.Dispose() }
Write-Output "SOURCE_PROFILE_ACQUIRED profile=$($profile.profile_id) selected=$($orderedIds.Count) receipt=$profileReceiptPath"
````

````powershell
#requires -Version 7.0
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($PSScriptRoot)
$runner = Join-Path $root 'apply_source_profile.ps1'
$lock = Join-Path $root 'upstream-source-lock.json'
$profiles = Join-Path $root 'source-profiles'
$scratch = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('elite-source-profile-test-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
$utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)

function Expect-Failure([scriptblock]$Action, [string]$Expected) {
  $caught = $null
  try { & $Action } catch { $caught = $_ }
  if ($null -eq $caught) { throw 'negative action unexpectedly succeeded' }
  if ($caught.Exception.Message -notlike "*$Expected*") { throw $caught }
}

try {
  [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $scratch)
  $validProfiles=0
  foreach ($name in @(
    'secure-file-ingestion.json',
    'secure-archive-linux.json',
    'aws-secure-document-pipeline.json',
    'google-secure-document-pipeline.json',
    'microsoft-secure-document-pipeline.json',
    'document-intelligence.json',
    'strict-field-evaluation.json',
    'commerce-communications.json',
    'enterprise-platform.json',
    'tamper-evident-local-log.json',
    'authenticated-human-approval-aws.json',
    'relational-outbox-debezium.json',
    'cloudflare-network-edge.json',
    'openid-identity-authorization.json',
    'kubernetes-deploy-rollback.json',
    'google-grounded-text-extraction.json',
    'maintenance-runtime-artifacts.json',
    'maintenance-package-license-evidence.json',
    'maintenance-training-source-inspection.json',
    'maintenance-training-wheel-quarantine.json',
    'maintenance-telemetry-source-inspection.json',
    'maintenance-web-security-artifacts.json',
    'maintenance-sharp-native-input-inspection.json',
    'maintenance-mxe-native-origin-inspection.json',
    'maintenance-semver-license-quarantine.json'
  )) {
    & $runner -ProfilePath (Join-Path $profiles $name) -LockPath $lock -Destination (Join-Path $scratch 'unused') -ValidateOnly
    $validProfiles++
  }

  $documentProfile = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $profiles 'document-intelligence.json'), $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20
  if (@($documentProfile.source_ids).Count -ne 46 -or $documentProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'paddlepaddle-paddleocr-3.7.0' -or $documentProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'paddlepaddle-paddlex-3.7.2' -or $documentProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'aws-bda-blueprint-optimizer-purchase-order-ddb5ae4') { throw 'document intelligence source selection drifted' }
  if ((@($documentProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'confidence scores are not correctness' -or (@($documentProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'moving `main`') { throw 'document intelligence Paddle accuracy/model pin blockers drifted' }

  $awsProfile = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $profiles 'aws-secure-document-pipeline.json'), $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20
  if (@($awsProfile.source_ids).Count -ne 25 -or $awsProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'aws-serverless-mail-parser-70ac931' -or $awsProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'aws-security-ir-email-integration-08f11d4' -or $awsProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'aws-secure-transfer-family-474ca07' -or $awsProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'aws-file-transfer-sync-5ee79ee' -or $awsProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'aws-receipt-mobile-ingestion-6eb72bf' -or $awsProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'aws-powertools-python-3.34.0' -or $awsProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'aws-dynamodb-lock-client-1.5.0' -or $awsProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'aws-s3-endedupe-7209a02' -or $awsProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'aws-sqs-best-practices-cdk-54143c7') { throw 'AWS intake source selection drifted' }
  if ((@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'never extracts attachments' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'Records\[0\]' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'same upload root' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'at-least-once' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'first-copy flag' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'transfer IDs' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch '14 root plus 13 frontend vulnerabilities' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'pre-auth debug/test' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'variable-length hexadecimal sequencers' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch '30 vulnerability occurrences/23 unique IDs' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'official wheel/sdist SLSA' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'DynamoDB update/delete lack owner fencing' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'random UUID' -or (@($awsProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'eleven runtime plus four test advisory IDs') { throw 'AWS intake rejection blockers drifted' }

  $base = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $profiles 'enterprise-platform.json'), $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20
  if (@($base.source_ids).Count -ne 22 -or $base.source_ids -cnotcontains 'microsoft-playwright-1.62.1' -or $base.source_ids -cnotcontains 'google-lighthouse-13.4.1' -or $base.source_ids -cnotcontains 'google-safevalues-1.2.0' -or $base.source_ids -cnotcontains 'google-csp-evaluator-1.1.8' -or $base.source_ids -cnotcontains 'grafana-k6-2.2.0' -or $base.source_ids -cnotcontains 'postgresql-18.6' -or $base.source_ids -cnotcontains 'owasp-zap-2.17.0' -or $base.source_ids -cnotcontains 'cloudflare-go-7.9.0' -or $base.source_ids -cnotcontains 'openid-foundation-conformance-suite-5.2.4' -or $base.source_ids -cnotcontains 'kubernetes-kubectl-1.37.0' -or (@($base.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'authenticated roles' -or (@($base.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'automated lab evidence' -or (@($base.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'code paths' -or (@($base.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'not an official Google product' -or (@($base.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'representative workload' -or (@($base.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'test restore' -or (@($base.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'zero findings' -or (@($base.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'Full \(strict\) TLS' -or (@($base.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'cross-tenant' -or (@($base.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'prior-digest restoration') { throw 'Enterprise platform browser security/quality/edge/identity/deploy selection drifted' }
  $cloudflareProfile = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $profiles 'cloudflare-network-edge.json'), $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20
  if (@($cloudflareProfile.source_ids).Count -ne 2 -or $cloudflareProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'cloudflare-pingora-0.8.1' -or $cloudflareProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'cloudflare-go-7.9.0' -or (@($cloudflareProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'proxied DNS') { throw 'Cloudflare edge source selection drifted' }
  $identityProfile = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $profiles 'openid-identity-authorization.json'), $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20
  if (@($identityProfile.source_ids).Count -ne 2 -or $identityProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'openid-foundation-conformance-suite-5.2.4' -or $identityProfile.source_ids -cnotcontains 'microsoft-playwright-1.62.1' -or (@($identityProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'cross-tenant' -or (@($identityProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'formal OpenID certification') { throw 'OpenID identity/authorization source selection drifted' }
  $deployProfile = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $profiles 'kubernetes-deploy-rollback.json'), $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20
  if (@($deployProfile.source_ids).Count -ne 1 -or $deployProfile.source_ids[0] -cne 'kubernetes-kubectl-1.37.0' -or (@($deployProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'prior-digest' -or (@($deployProfile.production_blockers) -join "`n") -notmatch 'migration') { throw 'Kubernetes deploy/rollback source selection drifted' }
  $base.source_ids = @('not-in-lock')
  $unknown = Join-Path $scratch 'unknown.json'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($unknown, ($base | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20), $utf8)
  Expect-Failure { & $runner -ProfilePath $unknown -LockPath $lock -Destination (Join-Path $scratch 'unused') -ValidateOnly } 'source is not in the exact lock'

  $base.source_ids = @('google-osv-scanner-2.5.1','google-osv-scanner-2.5.1')
  $duplicate = Join-Path $scratch 'duplicate.json'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($duplicate, ($base | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20), $utf8)
  Expect-Failure { & $runner -ProfilePath $duplicate -LockPath $lock -Destination (Join-Path $scratch 'unused') -ValidateOnly } 'duplicate source id'

  $base.source_ids = @('google-osv-scanner-2.5.1')
  $base.production_blockers = @()
  $missingGate = Join-Path $scratch 'missing-gate.json'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($missingGate, ($base | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20), $utf8)
  Expect-Failure { & $runner -ProfilePath $missingGate -LockPath $lock -Destination (Join-Path $scratch 'unused') -ValidateOnly } 'production_blockers must be explicit'

  Expect-Failure { & $runner -ProfilePath (Join-Path $profiles 'enterprise-platform.json') -LockPath $lock -Destination (Join-Path $scratch 'not-acquired') } 'ApprovalPath is required for acquisition'

  $validProfilePath = Join-Path $profiles 'enterprise-platform.json'
  $validProfile = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($validProfilePath, $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20
  $badApproval = [ordered]@{
    schema = 'elite-project-official-source-profile-approval/v1'
    profile_id = $validProfile.profile_id
    profile_sha256 = ('0' * 64)
    lock_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $lock -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    approved_by = 'test-owner'
    approved_at = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
    answers = @($validProfile.required_user_inputs | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ input=$_; status='ANSWERED'; response_or_reason='test' } })
    production_blockers_acknowledged = @($validProfile.production_blockers)
  }
  $badApprovalPath = Join-Path $scratch 'bad-approval.json'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($badApprovalPath, ($badApproval | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20), $utf8)
  Expect-Failure { & $runner -ProfilePath $validProfilePath -LockPath $lock -Destination (Join-Path $scratch 'not-acquired') -ApprovalPath $badApprovalPath } 'approval profile_sha256 mismatch'

  $positiveSourceId = 'google-osv-scanner-2.5.1'
  $lockedSource = ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($lock, $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20).sources | Where-Object id -CEQ $positiveSourceId
  $positiveProfile = [ordered]@{
    schema = 'elite-official-source-profile/v1'
    profile_id = 'offline-positive-regression'
    purpose = 'Exercise successful profile acquisition from an already verified source receipt without network.'
    source_ids = @($positiveSourceId)
    required_user_inputs = @('offline regression authorization')
    production_blockers = @('fixture receipt is not production approval')
  }
  $positiveProfilePath = Join-Path $scratch 'positive-profile.json'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($positiveProfilePath, (($positiveProfile | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20) + "`n"), $utf8)
  $positiveApproval = [ordered]@{
    schema = 'elite-project-official-source-profile-approval/v1'
    profile_id = $positiveProfile.profile_id
    profile_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $positiveProfilePath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    lock_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $lock -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    approved_by = 'offline-regression'
    approved_at = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
    answers = @([ordered]@{ input='offline regression authorization'; status='PROVEN'; response_or_reason='test fixture only'; evidence=@() })
    production_blockers_acknowledged = @($positiveProfile.production_blockers)
  }
  $positiveApprovalPath = Join-Path $scratch 'positive-approval.json'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($positiveApprovalPath, (($positiveApproval | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20) + "`n"), $utf8)
  $positiveDestination = Join-Path $scratch 'positive-destination'
  $positiveSourceRoot = Join-Path $positiveDestination "sources/$positiveSourceId"
  $positiveReceiptRoot = Join-Path $positiveDestination 'receipts'
  [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $positiveSourceRoot, $positiveReceiptRoot)
  $sourceReceipt = [ordered]@{
    schema = 'elite-official-source-receipt/v1'
    id = $positiveSourceId
    repository = $lockedSource.repository
    release = $lockedSource.release
    commit = $lockedSource.commit
    archive_url = $lockedSource.archive_url
    archive_bytes = $lockedSource.archive_bytes
    archive_sha256 = $lockedSource.archive_sha256
    license_expression = $lockedSource.license_expression
    platform = 'test-fixture'
    acquired_at = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
  }
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $positiveReceiptRoot "$positiveSourceId.json"), (($sourceReceipt | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) + "`n"), $utf8)
  Expect-Failure { & $runner -ProfilePath $positiveProfilePath -LockPath $lock -Destination $positiveDestination -ApprovalPath $positiveApprovalPath } 'legacy source cache cannot prove extracted bytes'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $positiveDestination 'profile-receipts/offline-positive-regression.json')) { throw 'empty source emitted a profile receipt' }
  Expect-Failure { Expect-Failure {} 'sentinel-never-thrown' } 'negative action unexpectedly succeeded'

  Write-Output "SOURCE_PROFILE_TEST_PASS valid=$validProfiles negatives=7 positives=0 opaque_positive_suite=separate"
} finally {
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $scratch) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $scratch -Recurse -Force }
}
````

````powershell
#requires -Version 7.0
# AUTHORED transport adapter. Opaque bytes only: never extract/install/execute.
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

function Opaque-Fail([string]$Message) { throw "OPAQUE_ARTIFACT_FAILED: $Message" }
function Opaque-ExactProperties($Value, [string[]]$Names, [string]$Label) {
  if ($null -eq $Value -or (($Value.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object) -join '|') -cne (($Names | Sort-Object) -join '|')) { Opaque-Fail "$Label fields differ" }
}
function Assert-OpaqueNoReparse([string]$Path) {
  $current = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
  while ($current) {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $current) {
      $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $current -Force

function Get-OpaqueHash([string]$Path, [string]$Algorithm = 'SHA256') {

function Get-OpaqueLicenseBytes($Source, [string]$LockRoot) {

function New-OpaqueHttpClient {
  $handler = [Net.Http.HttpClientHandler]::new()
  $handler.AllowAutoRedirect = $false
  $handler.UseCookies = $false
  $handler.UseDefaultCredentials = $false
  $client = [Net.Http.HttpClient]::new($handler, $true)
  $client.Timeout = [TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(60)
  return $client
}
function Copy-OpaqueBounded([IO.Stream]$InputStream, [IO.Stream]$OutputStream, $Source, [Threading.CancellationToken]$CancellationToken) {
  $hasher = [Security.Cryptography.IncrementalHash]::CreateHash([Security.Cryptography.HashAlgorithmName]::new($Source.artifact_digest.algorithm.ToUpperInvariant()))
  try {
    $buffer = [byte[]]::new(65536)
    [long]$count = 0
    while ($true) {
      $CancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
      $amount = $InputStream.ReadAsync($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length, $CancellationToken).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
      if ($amount -eq 0) { break }
      if ($count + $amount -gt [long]$Source.artifact_bytes) { Opaque-Fail 'response exceeds exact size budget' }
      $OutputStream.Write($buffer, 0, $amount)
      $hasher.AppendData($buffer, 0, $amount)
      $count += $amount
    }
    if ($count -ne [long]$Source.artifact_bytes) { Opaque-Fail 'artifact size mismatch' }
    $digest = [Convert]::ToHexString($hasher.GetHashAndReset()).ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($digest -cne $Source.artifact_digest.value) { Opaque-Fail 'artifact digest mismatch' }
    return $count
  } finally { $hasher.Dispose() }
}
function Assert-OpaqueReceipt($Source, $Receipt, [string]$ProfilePath, [string]$ApprovalPath, [string]$LockPath) {
  if ($Receipt.schema -cne 'elite-official-source-receipt/v1' -or $Receipt.transport_kind -cne 'opaque-release-artifact/v1' -or $Receipt.id -cne $Source.id -or $Receipt.commit -cne $Source.commit) { Opaque-Fail 'receipt source identity differs' }
  if ($Receipt.artifact_bytes -ne $Source.artifact_bytes -or $Receipt.artifact_digest.algorithm -cne $Source.artifact_digest.algorithm -or $Receipt.artifact_digest.value -cne $Source.artifact_digest.value -or $Receipt.license_sha256 -cne $Source.license_sha256) { Opaque-Fail 'receipt artifact identity differs' }
  foreach ($key in @('repository','release','artifact_url','artifact_filename','license_expression')) { if ($Receipt.$key -cne $Source.$key) { Opaque-Fail 'receipt source metadata differs' } }
  if ($Receipt.input_mode -cnotin @('exact_import','official_https') -or $Receipt.platform -cne 'windows') { Opaque-Fail 'receipt transport metadata differs' }
  if ($Receipt.profile_sha256 -cne (Get-OpaqueHash $ProfilePath) -or $Receipt.approval_sha256 -cne (Get-OpaqueHash $ApprovalPath) -or $Receipt.lock_sha256 -cne (Get-OpaqueHash $LockPath)) { Opaque-Fail 'receipt governance binding differs' }
  foreach ($flag in @('extracted','installed','executed','production_admitted')) {
    if ($Receipt.$flag -isnot [bool] -or $Receipt.$flag -ne $false) { Opaque-Fail 'receipt exceeds opaque transport claim' }
  }
}
function Invoke-OpaqueAcquisition($Source, [string]$LockPath, [string]$Target, [string]$ReceiptPath, [string]$ProfilePath, [string]$ApprovalPath, [string]$ImportDirectory = '') {
  $lockRoot = Split-Path -Parent ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($LockPath))
  Assert-OpaqueSource $Source $lockRoot
  foreach ($path in @($Target,$ReceiptPath,$LockPath,$ProfilePath,$ApprovalPath)) { Assert-OpaqueNoReparse $path }
  $artifact = Join-Path $Target $Source.artifact_filename
  $license = Join-Path $Target 'LICENSE.txt'
  if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $Target) -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ReceiptPath)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ReceiptPath -PathType Leaf) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifact -PathType Leaf) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $license -PathType Leaf)) { Opaque-Fail 'occupied output has incomplete evidence' }
    foreach ($path in @($artifact,$license)) { Assert-OpaqueNoReparse $path }
    if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $artifact).Length -ne $Source.artifact_bytes -or (Get-OpaqueHash $artifact $Source.artifact_digest.algorithm) -cne $Source.artifact_digest.value -or (Get-OpaqueHash $license) -cne $Source.license_sha256) { Opaque-Fail 'occupied artifact bytes drifted' }
    if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $ReceiptPath).Length -gt 131072) { Opaque-Fail 'receipt exceeds read budget' }
    $existing = Get-Content -LiteralPath $ReceiptPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 20
    Assert-OpaqueReceipt $Source $existing $ProfilePath $ApprovalPath $LockPath
    if ($existing.artifact_sha256 -cne (Get-OpaqueHash $artifact)) { Opaque-Fail 'receipt observed SHA256 differs' }
    Write-Output "OPAQUE_ARTIFACT_PRESENT id=$($Source.id) rehashed=true"
    return
  }
  [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Target)
  $partial = Join-Path $Target ($Source.artifact_filename + '.partial')
  $output = $null; $inputStream = $null; $client = $null; $response = $null
  $deadline = [Threading.CancellationTokenSource]::new([TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(60))
  try {
    $output = [IO.FileStream]::new($partial, [IO.FileMode]::CreateNew, [IO.FileAccess]::Write, [IO.FileShare]::None)
    if ($ImportDirectory) {
      $imported = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ImportDirectory)) $Source.artifact_filename
      Assert-OpaqueNoReparse $imported
      if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $imported -PathType Leaf)) { Opaque-Fail 'exact imported artifact is missing' }
      $inputStream = [IO.FileStream]::new($imported, [IO.FileMode]::Open, [IO.FileAccess]::Read, [IO.FileShare]::Read)
    } else {
      $client = New-OpaqueHttpClient
      $response = $client.GetAsync([uri]$Source.artifact_url, [Net.Http.HttpCompletionOption]::ResponseHeadersRead, $deadline.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
      if ($response.StatusCode -ne [Net.HttpStatusCode]::OK) { Opaque-Fail 'HTTP status must be 200; redirects are rejected' }
      $inputStream = $response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync($deadline.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
    }
    $actualBytes = Copy-OpaqueBounded $inputStream $output $Source $deadline.Token
    $output.Flush($true)
  } finally {
    if ($inputStream) { $inputStream.Dispose() }; if ($output) { $output.Dispose() }
    if ($response) { $response.Dispose() }; if ($client) { $client.Dispose() }; $deadline.Dispose()
  }
  [IO.File]::Move($partial, $artifact, $false)
  $licenseBytes = Get-OpaqueLicenseBytes $Source $lockRoot
  $licenseStream = [IO.FileStream]::new($license,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write,[IO.FileShare]::None)
  try { $licenseStream.Write($licenseBytes,0,$licenseBytes.Length); $licenseStream.Flush($true) } finally { $licenseStream.Dispose() }
  if ((Get-OpaqueHash $license) -cne $Source.license_sha256) { Opaque-Fail 'copied license drifted' }
  $record = [ordered]@{
    schema='elite-official-source-receipt/v1'; id=$Source.id; repository=$Source.repository; release=$Source.release; commit=$Source.commit
    transport_kind='opaque-release-artifact/v1'; artifact_url=$Source.artifact_url; artifact_filename=$Source.artifact_filename
    artifact_bytes=$actualBytes; artifact_digest=$Source.artifact_digest; artifact_sha256=(Get-OpaqueHash $artifact)
    license_expression=$Source.license_expression; license_sha256=$Source.license_sha256
    profile_sha256=(Get-OpaqueHash $ProfilePath); approval_sha256=(Get-OpaqueHash $ApprovalPath); lock_sha256=(Get-OpaqueHash $LockPath)
    extracted=$false; installed=$false; executed=$false; production_admitted=$false; platform='windows'
    input_mode=$(if ($ImportDirectory) {'exact_import'} else {'official_https'}); acquired_at=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
  }
  $bytes = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).GetBytes(($record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) + "`n")
  $receiptStream = [IO.FileStream]::new($ReceiptPath, [IO.FileMode]::CreateNew, [IO.FileAccess]::Write, [IO.FileShare]::None)
  try { $receiptStream.Write($bytes,0,$bytes.Length); $receiptStream.Flush($true) } finally { $receiptStream.Dispose() }
  Write-Output "OPAQUE_ARTIFACT_ACQUIRED id=$($Source.id) extracted=false installed=false executed=false"
}
````

| `LockPath` | path | none | JSON schema/commit/hash/license exactos | no | por ejecución | autoridad de adquisición |
| `Destination` | path | none | absoluto resuelto; target legado ausente; opaco existente sólo con bytes y recibos revalidados | no | por proyecto | raíz `sources/receipts` |
| `SourceId` | array | todos | sólo IDs del lock | no | por ejecución | subset adquirido |
| `ProfilePath` | path | none | schema, IDs, user inputs y production blockers explícitos | no | por ejecución | selección cerrada de upstreams oficiales |
| `ApprovalPath` | path | none | requerido salvo `-ValidateOnly`; perfil/lock SHA, respuestas y blockers exactos | no | por adquisición | autorización machine-readable del proyecto |

| `PythonExecutable` | path | none | archivo ejecutable, Python compatible | no | por proyecto | crea venv Spec Kit |
| `Integration` | enum | `codex` | `codex|claude` | no | bootstrap | assets oficiales del agente |
| `PythonExecutable` | path | none | entorno contiene Docling 2.122.0 | no | por entorno | API oficial |

| `OcrBackend` | enum | `torch` | `torch|onnxruntime`; dependencia correspondiente instalada | no | por corrida | backend RapidOCR oficial |

## 8. Apply order

1. Materializar este pack en un target vacío o componerlo sin colisiones.
2. Ejecutar `test_upstream_acquisition.ps1`, `test_source_profiles.ps1` y `test_opaque_artifact_transport.ps1`.
3. Elegir un perfil sólo después de completar sus `required_user_inputs`; ejecutar `apply_source_profile.ps1 -ValidateOnly`.
4. Adquirir únicamente el perfil aprobado. El runner escribe receipts por source y un receipt agregado del perfil; nunca convierte blockers en aprobación.
5. Para el harness, adquirir Spec Kit y ejecutar `bootstrap_spec_kit_no_git.ps1` contra proyecto vacío o proyecto existente sin `.specify`/`.git`.
6. Para documentos, adquirir Docling, crear el entorno desde su `uv.lock` frozen y pasar `docling` exacto a `invoke_docling_local.ps1`.
7. Conservar licenses, notices, receipts, SBOM y conversion records.
8. En workspace existente, no sobreescribir archivos; resolver composición/paths primero. Rollback: retirar solamente los directorios nuevos `elite_upstreams`, `.specify-venv`, `.specify` e integración del agente si no contienen trabajo posterior, preservando records.
