````powershell
#requires -Version 7.0
# AUTHORED bounded inspection-only lane. No license/source/runtime admission.
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
function Assert-QuarantineWheel($Source) {
  Opaque-ExactProperties $Source @('id','transport_kind','package','version','artifact_filename','artifact_url','artifact_bytes','artifact_digest','registry_metadata_sha256','core_metadata_sha256','license_review_status','source_identity_status','supported_platforms','platform_condition','purpose') 'quarantine source'
  foreach ($key in @('id','transport_kind','package','version','artifact_filename','artifact_url','registry_metadata_sha256','core_metadata_sha256','license_review_status','source_identity_status','platform_condition','purpose')) {
    if ($Source.$key -isnot [string]) { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine source text required' }
  }
  if ($Source.transport_kind -cne 'quarantined-pypi-wheel/v1' -or $Source.package -cnotmatch '^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$' -or $Source.version -cnotmatch '^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+){1,3}(?:rc(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)|\.post[0-9]+)?$') { Opaque-Fail 'invalid quarantine package/version' }
  if ($Source.id -cne ('quarantine-pypi-' + $Source.package + '-' + $Source.version) -or $Source.id.Length -gt 100) { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine id mismatch' }
  $prefix = $Source.package.Replace('-','_') + '-' + $Source.version + '-'
  if (-not $Source.artifact_filename.StartsWith($prefix,[StringComparison]::Ordinal) -or $Source.artifact_filename -cnotmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+-[A-Za-z0-9_.]+-[A-Za-z0-9_.]+-[A-Za-z0-9_.]+\.whl$') { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine wheel filename mismatch' }
  $urlPattern = '^https://files\.pythonhosted\.org/packages/[0-9a-f]{2}/[0-9a-f]{2}/[0-9a-f]{60}/' + [regex]::Escape($Source.artifact_filename) + '$'
  if ($Source.artifact_url -cnotmatch $urlPattern) { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine URL must be an exact PyPI wheel URL' }
  if (($Source.artifact_bytes -isnot [long] -and $Source.artifact_bytes -isnot [int]) -or $Source.artifact_bytes -le 0 -or $Source.artifact_bytes -gt 134217728) { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine wheel outside finite byte budget' }
  Opaque-ExactProperties $Source.artifact_digest @('algorithm','value') 'quarantine digest'
  if ($Source.artifact_digest.algorithm -cne 'sha256' -or $Source.artifact_digest.value -isnot [string] -or $Source.artifact_digest.value -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine SHA256 required' }
  if ($Source.registry_metadata_sha256 -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or $Source.core_metadata_sha256 -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine metadata digests required' }
  if ($Source.license_review_status -cne 'PENDING_ARTIFACT_INSPECTION' -or $Source.source_identity_status -cne 'REGISTRY_METADATA_ONLY') { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine source cannot claim admission' }
  if ($Source.supported_platforms -isnot [array] -or $Source.supported_platforms.Count -ne 1 -or $Source.supported_platforms[0] -cne 'windows') { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine transport qualified only on Windows' }
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Source.purpose) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Source.platform_condition)) { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine scope must be explicit' }
}

function Assert-QuarantineNpm($Source) {
  Opaque-ExactProperties $Source @('id','transport_kind','package','version','artifact_filename','artifact_url','artifact_bytes','artifact_digest','registry_metadata_sha256','registry_evidence_sha256','license_review_status','source_identity_status','supported_platforms','platform_condition','purpose') 'npm quarantine source'
  foreach ($key in @('id','transport_kind','package','version','artifact_filename','artifact_url','registry_metadata_sha256','registry_evidence_sha256','license_review_status','source_identity_status','platform_condition','purpose')) {
    if ($Source.$key -isnot [string]) { Opaque-Fail 'npm quarantine source text required' }
  }
  # Intentionally one reviewed inspection target, never a generic npm installer.
  if ($Source.transport_kind -cne 'quarantined-npm-tarball/v1' -or $Source.package -cne 'semver-utils' -or $Source.version -cne '1.1.4' -or $Source.id -cne 'quarantine-npm-semver-utils-1.1.4') { Opaque-Fail 'npm quarantine identity not reviewed' }
  if ($Source.artifact_filename -cne 'semver-utils-1.1.4.tgz' -or $Source.artifact_url -cne 'https://registry.npmjs.org/semver-utils/-/semver-utils-1.1.4.tgz') { Opaque-Fail 'npm quarantine exact registry URL/filename required' }
  if (($Source.artifact_bytes -isnot [long] -and $Source.artifact_bytes -isnot [int]) -or $Source.artifact_bytes -le 0 -or $Source.artifact_bytes -gt 1048576) { Opaque-Fail 'npm quarantine outside finite byte budget' }
  Opaque-ExactProperties $Source.artifact_digest @('algorithm','value') 'npm quarantine digest'
  if ($Source.artifact_digest.algorithm -cne 'sha512' -or $Source.artifact_digest.value -isnot [string] -or $Source.artifact_digest.value -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{128}$') { Opaque-Fail 'npm quarantine SHA512 required' }
  if ($Source.registry_metadata_sha256 -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or $Source.registry_evidence_sha256 -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { Opaque-Fail 'npm quarantine metadata/evidence digests required' }
  if ($Source.license_review_status -cne 'PENDING_ARTIFACT_INSPECTION' -or $Source.source_identity_status -cne 'REGISTRY_METADATA_ONLY') { Opaque-Fail 'npm quarantine source cannot claim admission' }
  if ($Source.supported_platforms -isnot [array] -or $Source.supported_platforms.Count -ne 1 -or $Source.supported_platforms[0] -cne 'windows') { Opaque-Fail 'npm quarantine transport qualified only on Windows' }
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Source.purpose) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Source.platform_condition)) { Opaque-Fail 'npm quarantine scope must be explicit' }
}
function Assert-QuarantineSource($Source) {
  if ($Source.transport_kind -ceq 'quarantined-pypi-wheel/v1') { Assert-QuarantineWheel $Source }
  elseif ($Source.transport_kind -ceq 'quarantined-npm-tarball/v1') { Assert-QuarantineNpm $Source }
  else { Opaque-Fail 'unknown quarantine transport' }
}

function New-QuarantineReceipt($Source,[string]$ProfilePath,[string]$ApprovalPath,[string]$LockPath,[string]$InputMode) {
  $record = [ordered]@{
    schema='elite-quarantined-wheel-receipt/v1'; id=$Source.id; transport_kind=$Source.transport_kind; package=$Source.package; version=$Source.version
    artifact_url=$Source.artifact_url; artifact_filename=$Source.artifact_filename; artifact_bytes=$Source.artifact_bytes; artifact_sha256=$Source.artifact_digest.value
    registry_metadata_sha256=$Source.registry_metadata_sha256; core_metadata_sha256=$(if($Source.transport_kind -ceq 'quarantined-pypi-wheel/v1'){$Source.core_metadata_sha256}else{''})
    profile_sha256=(Get-OpaqueHash $ProfilePath); approval_sha256=(Get-OpaqueHash $ApprovalPath); lock_sha256=(Get-OpaqueHash $LockPath)
    status='QUARANTINED_NOT_ADMITTED'; license_review_status='PENDING_ARTIFACT_INSPECTION'; source_identity_status='REGISTRY_METADATA_ONLY'
    extracted=$false; installed=$false; executed=$false; production_admitted=$false; native_components_scanned=$false; signatures_verified=$false
    input_mode=$InputMode; acquired_at=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
  }

  if ($Source.transport_kind -ceq 'quarantined-npm-tarball/v1') {
    $record.schema='elite-quarantined-npm-tarball-receipt/v1'
    $record.Remove('artifact_sha256');$record.Remove('core_metadata_sha256')
    $record.artifact_sha512=$Source.artifact_digest.value
    $record.registry_evidence_sha256=$Source.registry_evidence_sha256
  }
  return $record
}
function Assert-QuarantineReceipt($Source,$Receipt,[string]$ProfilePath,[string]$ApprovalPath,[string]$LockPath) {
  $expected = New-QuarantineReceipt $Source $ProfilePath $ApprovalPath $LockPath 'official_https'
  Opaque-ExactProperties $Receipt @($expected.Keys) 'quarantine receipt'
  foreach ($key in $expected.Keys) {
    if ($key -in @('input_mode','acquired_at')) { continue }
    if ($expected[$key] -is [bool]) {
      if ($Receipt.$key -isnot [bool] -or $Receipt.$key -ne $false) { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine receipt inflated a claim' }
    } elseif ($Receipt.$key -cne $expected[$key]) { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine receipt binding differs' }
  }
  if ($Receipt.input_mode -cnotin @('official_https','exact_import')) { Opaque-Fail 'invalid quarantine input mode' }
  $date=[DateTimeOffset]::MinValue
  if (-not [DateTimeOffset]::TryParse([string]$Receipt.acquired_at,[ref]$date)) { Opaque-Fail 'invalid quarantine acquisition timestamp' }
}
function Invoke-QuarantineAcquisition($Source,[string]$LockPath,[string]$Target,[string]$ReceiptPath,[string]$ProfilePath,[string]$ApprovalPath,[string]$ImportDirectory='') {
  Assert-QuarantineSource $Source
  foreach ($path in @($Target,$ReceiptPath,$LockPath,$ProfilePath,$ApprovalPath)) { Assert-OpaqueNoReparse $path }
  $artifact=Join-Path $Target $Source.artifact_filename
  if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $Target) -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ReceiptPath)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ReceiptPath -PathType Leaf) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifact -PathType Leaf)) { Opaque-Fail 'occupied quarantine output is incomplete' }
    Assert-OpaqueNoReparse $artifact
    if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $ReceiptPath).Length -gt 131072) { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine receipt exceeds read budget' }
    $existing=Get-Content -LiteralPath $ReceiptPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 10
    Assert-QuarantineReceipt $Source $existing $ProfilePath $ApprovalPath $LockPath
    if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $artifact).Length -ne $Source.artifact_bytes -or (Get-OpaqueHash $artifact $Source.artifact_digest.algorithm) -cne $Source.artifact_digest.value) { Opaque-Fail 'occupied quarantine artifact drifted' }
    Write-Output "QUARANTINE_PRESENT id=$($Source.id) rehashed=true admitted=false"
    return
  }
  [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Target)
  $partial=Join-Path $Target ($Source.artifact_filename+'.partial')
  $output=$null;$inputStream=$null;$client=$null;$response=$null
  $deadline=[Threading.CancellationTokenSource]::new([TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(60))
  try {
    $output=[IO.FileStream]::new($partial,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write,[IO.FileShare]::None)
    if ($ImportDirectory) {
      $imported=Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ImportDirectory)) $Source.artifact_filename;Assert-OpaqueNoReparse $imported
      if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $imported -PathType Leaf)) { Opaque-Fail 'exact quarantine import is missing' }
      $inputStream=[IO.FileStream]::new($imported,[IO.FileMode]::Open,[IO.FileAccess]::Read,[IO.FileShare]::Read)
    } else {
      $client=New-OpaqueHttpClient
      $response=$client.GetAsync([uri]$Source.artifact_url,[Net.Http.HttpCompletionOption]::ResponseHeadersRead,$deadline.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
      if ($response.StatusCode -ne [Net.HttpStatusCode]::OK) { Opaque-Fail 'quarantine HTTP status must be200; no redirects' }
      $inputStream=$response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync($deadline.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
    }
    [void](Copy-OpaqueBounded $inputStream $output $Source $deadline.Token);$output.Flush($true)
  } finally {
    if ($inputStream) {$inputStream.Dispose()};if ($output) {$output.Dispose()};if ($response) {$response.Dispose()};if ($client) {$client.Dispose()};$deadline.Dispose()
  }
  [IO.File]::Move($partial,$artifact,$false)
  $record=New-QuarantineReceipt $Source $ProfilePath $ApprovalPath $LockPath $(if($ImportDirectory){'exact_import'}else{'official_https'})
  $bytes=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).GetBytes(($record|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10)+"`n")
  $stream=[IO.FileStream]::new($ReceiptPath,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write,[IO.FileShare]::None)
  try {$stream.Write($bytes,0,$bytes.Length);$stream.Flush($true)}finally{$stream.Dispose()}
  Write-Output "QUARANTINE_ACQUIRED id=$($Source.id) extracted=false installed=false executed=false admitted=false"
}

Perfil materializado,inputs respondidos y binding de aprobación siguen obligatorios.55checks nuevos de metadata,scope,hash/tamaño,ocupación,replay,approval;98opacos anteriores,20perfiles y9negativos previos PASS.
